The graph tracks every file, directory, exported symbol, and their relationships so an agent "},{"id":"p3s3","text":"can answer structural and dependency questions faster than grepping or reading files."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> **Status: infancy.** This project is in its infancy stage. Execution behavior, the query surface, "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"and compatibility may change while the project is iterated on and tested by the open source communit"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"d compatibility may change while the project is iterated on and tested by the open source community."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Derived work.** This project is derived from the knowledge graph tool in Luke-Yong/H, adapted to"},{"id":"p5s2","text":" DeepSeek Harness's "everything is a plugin" model."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Given a workspace root, the plugin builds an in-memory graph and answers queries such as:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- `structure` — print the full directory tree
- `exports <file>` — list every symbol exported by a f"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ile
- `imports_of <file>` — list symbols a file imports (with their source files; stdlib/third-party"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" imports are tagged)
- `exporters_of <symbol>` — find which files export a symbol
- `dependents <fil"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"e>` — find which files import from a file
- `unused_imports <file>` — list imports never referenced "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"which files import from a file
- `unused_imports <file>` — list imports never referenced in the file"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Symbols are parsed from TypeScript/JavaScript (via the TypeScript compiler API) and Python (module-l"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"evel `def`, `class`, and `name = value` bindings)."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Graph model"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The graph uses three node types and four edge types:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Nodes | Meaning |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `dir` | A directory |
| `file` | A source file |
| `symbol` | An exported symbol (function, class,"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" const, type, interface, enum, default) |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| Edges | Meaning |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| `CONTAINS` | Structural parent → child (dir → dir/file, file → symbol) |
| `EXPORTS` | File → symb"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ol it exports |
| `IMPORTS` | File-level dependency (file → file) |
| `IMPORTS_SYMBOL` | Precise sym"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"bol-level dependency (file → symbol) |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Install with the DSH CLI into a profile:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Pin to a specific commit for reproducibility:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The plugin registers a single tool, `read_graph`, on `ctx.tools`. Its parameters:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `query` | string | yes | Query string in `<query_type> <target>` form |
| `root` | string | no | A"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"bsolute workspace root to graph. Defaults to `process.cwd()` |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"> **Root hygiene:** the `root` default (`process.cwd()`) may be a parent directory containing severa"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"l independent projects. Always pass an explicit `root` pointing at the single workspace you are work"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"ing in, so `structure` doesn't descend into sibling trees."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Example queries:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Project structure"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Building"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Output is emitted to `dist/` (`dist/index.js` is the package entry point)."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
